headline: Oil Rises 2.3 Percent To 102.2 As Silver Falls 0.79 Percent
narrative: Crude oil rose 2.3 percent to 102.2, the energy pipe taking the session bid. Silver fell 0.79 percent to 53.87 and gold eased 0.35 percent to 4,060.5, so money left the precious-metals pipe as oil took the bid. Copper rose 0.47 percent to 6.65, a smaller industrial bid that moved with oil rather than with silver.
author: jordan
